query: FourMeme BSC memecoin launches recent September 2026 trending tokens liquidity volume
content:
**FourMeme (four.meme) is a popular BSC memecoin launchpad** on Binance Smart Chain that hosts fair-launch or bonding-curve tokens. Tokens launch directly on its platform (often via DEX integrations like PancakeSwap), then graduate to live trading. It powers a major share of BSC meme activity, with hundreds of launches in 2026. [[1]](https://dune.com/mwuhjyf/memecoin-launch-on-fourmeme) [[2]](https://www.geckoterminal.com/category/fourmeme-launchpad)

As of September 13, 2026, FourMeme has launched hundreds of trending tokens recently (mostly early September). Data from DexScreener and analytics platforms shows elevated 24h volumes and liquidity for top pairs, with some volume spikes from new launches or fast-moving ones (e.g., $4Stock hitting $40M+ MC in hours). [[3]](https://www.sharpe.ai/dexscreener/bsc/dex/four-meme/trending) [[4]](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/4stock-meme-coin-surpasses-40m-market-cap-in-2-hours-on-bsc)

### Key Trends and Recent Launches (Early-to-Mid September 2026)
- **Stock-themed plays dominate**: $4Stock (4STOCK) is the standout. Launched ~September 8–9 on FourMeme, it tokenized popular stocks (1:1 backed, enabling "stock memes" on BSC). It briefly topped $70M MC and saw explosive early volume before settling. Contract: 0x2fe13112be502026671a6e76af45d14ec394022d (approx.). Now trading ~$0.0289 with $3.7M 24h volume and $221K liquidity. New listing on Gate.io (Sept 10) added visibility. [[5]](https://www.odaily.news/en/newsflash/516283) [[4]](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/4stock-meme-coin-surpasses-40m-market-cap-in-2-hours-on-bsc) [[3]](https://www.sharpe.ai/dexscreener/bsc/dex/four-meme/trending)
- **High-volume trending tokens** (from DexScreener FourMeme pool + Sharpe snapshot ~Sept 13):
  - **AKE (AKE)**: ~$20M 24h volume, $1.4M liquidity.
  - **龙虾 (Longxia / Lobster)**: ~$16.7M 24h volume, $1.6M liquidity (multiple pools; also ~$924K in another).
  - **牛来 (Niulai)**: ~$12.9M 24h volume, $976K liquidity.
  - **4Stock (4STOCK)**: ~$3.7M 24h volume, $221K liquidity (post-graduation).
  - Others in top trending: RADR (~$3M vol/$2.9M liq), BREW (~$6.5M vol/$392K liq), etc. Overall FourMeme pool activity: ~$629K 24h volume across 16k+ txns, but trending pairs show much higher spikes. [[6]](https://dexscreener.com/bsc/fourmeme) [[3]](https://www.sharpe.ai/dexscreener/bsc/dex/four-meme/trending)
- **Volume context**: FourMeme launchpad historically sees $35M+ daily tx volume in peak periods; Sept 2026 featured rallies (e.g., Marscoin >$260M MC earlier in month) and new formats like 4Stock. Many new tokens stay on the curve for hours/days before graduating. [[2]](https://www.geckoterminal.com/category/fourmeme-launchpad) [[7]](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/marscoin-market-cap-surpasses-260m-bsc-meme-coins-rally)

### Notable Recent Launches (Sept 2026 Context)
- $4Stock as the biggest hype driver (stock narrative + fast pumps).
- Various others like $Apu, $Squishy, $MAIL cat, $CHASE (launched mid-Sept, small MC/volume, bonding-curve phase). [[8]](https://x.com/bitecong/status/2098736442667332012) [[9]](https://x.com/bitecong/status/2098522909195317433)
- Broader BSC meme scene (Marscoin, 4Stock) saw MC surges on FourMeme-powered tokens. [[7]](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/marscoin-market-cap-surpasses-260m-bsc-meme-coins-rally)

**Liquidity and volume notes**: New tokens often start with modest liq (tens to hundreds of K) and ramp up post-graduation. Trending ones above show strong 24h figures amid the month’s rally. Total platform fees/revenue tracked on Dune; one recent example hit $21K+ in fees. [[1]](https://dune.com/mwuhjyf/memecoin-launch-on-fourmeme)

FourMeme remains a go-to for quick, fair launches on BSC with strong community/meme traction. Check DexScreener.com/bsc/fourmeme or four.meme directly for live charts, as data moves fast. Always DYOR—memecoins are highly volatile.

### 3. BSC Has a Mature Meme Trading Market

As of September 11, 2026, BSC had approximately $5.56 billion in Total Value Locked (TVL), 1.86 million active addresses over 24 hours, and around $13.30 billion in stablecoin market capitalization. During the same period, BSC recorded approximately $1.16 billion in 24-hour DEX trading volume, while its active RWA market cap stood at around $4.68 billion.

These figures highlight BSC’s substantial on-chain liquidity, user base, and trading activity. For Stock Meme projects, this provides an existing trading environment and established meme audience, reducing the need to build a market from scratch.

Image 45

_Source:Defillama_

## Top BSC Stock Meme Projects to Watch [...] The sector is growing rapidly. According to CoinMarketCap data as of September 10, 2026, the global tokenized stock market had approximately $2.55 billion in TVL and around $1.7 billion in on-chain trading volume. bStocks accounted for roughly 26% of TVL, but generated approximately 88% of total on-chain trading volume, highlighting its relatively high trading activity. By comparison, Ondo accounted for around 42% of TVL but only about 2% of trading volume, while xStocks represented approximately 32% of TVL and 10% of trading volume.

This is why bStocks are particularly important to the BSC Stock Meme ecosystem: they are not only tokenized stock assets but also serve as trading pairs and liquidity sources for some Stock Meme projects.

Image 44

## What Is 4Stock? [...] ### 5. BUILD

$BUILD is a Stock Meme token built around the BNC4 and CEA Industries (NASDAQ: BNC) stock narrative. $BUILD launched around September 8, 2026, and is paired with BNC4, the 4Stock product launched by Four.Meme.

One of $BUILD’s key features is its transaction tax mechanism. According to the project’s published distribution model, a portion of transaction taxes is used to purchase and accumulate $BNC, while another portion is distributed to $BUILD holders in the form of $BNC.

As a result, $BUILD is connected not only to the BNC4 and CEA Industries stock narrative, but also to $BNC through its transaction tax mechanism, creating a link between $BUILD, $BNC, and the broader Stock Meme narrative.

Image 50

### 6. MAX
